name: HF
description: Pick DeepSeek V4 Pro & Flash from the Copilot Chat model picker. Vision, thinking mode, agent tools — zero config, BYOK.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: Default API key for all models. Each model can override with its own key.

baseUrl.title: Default API Base URL
baseUrl.description: Defaults to https://api.deepseek.com. Each model can override with its own URL.

models.title: Models
models.description: Define your models here. Each entry appears in the Copilot Chat model picker.

defaultSnippets.label: DeepSeek V4 Flash
defaultSnippets.description: Official DeepSeek API — uses vendor-level baseUrl

id.description: Unique model ID shown in the picker.

name.description: Display name in the model picker.

detail.description: Short description shown below the model name.

url.patternErrorMessage: Must start with http:// or https://
url.description: API base URL for this model. Overrides the default base URL above.

apiKey.description: Per-model API key. Overrides the default API key above.

maxInputTokens.description: Maximum input tokens (for display in the model picker).

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens (for display in the model picker).

max_tokens.description: Max tokens sent in the API request. When 0 (default), no limit is sent — the API uses its own default (393216 for DeepSeek V4). Set to a positive value to enforce an explicit output token cap. IMPORTANT: setting this too low may truncate reasoning_content and break prompt cache hit rate across conversation turns.

toolCalling.description: Whether the model supports tool/function calling.

vision.description: Whether the model supports image input (vision).

thinking.description: Whether the model supports thinking/reasoning mode.

extraBody.description: Extra JSON fields to merge into the API request body. These fields override the extension's defaults — use this to customize parameters for third-party APIs (e.g. set stream: false, adjust temperature, add custom fields). Only model and messages are protected and cannot be overridden.

toolChoice.description: Per-model override for sending `tool_choice: "auto"`. Takes priority over the global `deepseek-copilot.compat.toolChoice` setting. Set to false if this model's endpoint rejects tool_choice.

compat.description: Per-model compat overrides. Takes priority over global `deepseek-copilot.compat.*` settings. Set thinkingParam to "always" for endpoints that support DeepSeek-style thinking; set to "never" to disable.

thinkingParam.description: Controls sending of `thinking` / `reasoning_effort` params and `reasoning_content` injection. Default "auto" disables these fields for safe compat. Set to "always" for endpoints that support DeepSeek-style thinking.

streamOptions.description: Controls sending of `stream_options: { include_usage: true }`. Set to "never" if the endpoint rejects this field.

toolChoice.description: Controls sending of `tool_choice: "auto"`. Set to "never" if the endpoint rejects tool_choice.

deepseek-copilot.visionPrompt.default:
Describe all image attachments in this message.

If there is one image, describe it directly.
If there are multiple images:
1. Describe each image separately, preserving their order.
2. Then provide a combined description explaining the overall context and relationships across the images.

Return one concise factual description suitable for inserting into a text-only chat prompt. Include visible text, objects, UI elements, people, and relevant context. Do not invent details.

scripts.clean: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('out', { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: process.platform === 'win32' ? 10 : 0 })"
scripts.package:win: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const pkg=require('./package.json');const orig=pkg.scripts['vscode:prepublish'];pkg.scripts['vscode:prepublish']='npm run compile';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(pkg,null,2)+'\n');try{require('child_process').execSync('vsce package --readme-path dist/README.marketplace.md -o dist/',{stdio:'inherit'})}finally{fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify({...pkg,scripts:{...pkg.scripts,'vscode:prepublish':orig}},null,2)+'\n')}"
